guitar.notes: Bradley Nowell played a Fender Stratocaster, well documented in Sublime live footage/photos.

tone.target: clean reggae-ska rhythm with slight edge-of-breakup and bright skank chop
tone.profile: clean reggae-ska rhythm with slight edge-of-breakup and bright skank chop
tone.summary: A tight signal chain using light compression and a mild OD boost into a Fender-style amp model (US Deluxe) paired with a small cabinet (US 2x12), emphasizing clarity and punchy attack.

rig.name: Sublime - What I Got - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and tighten the rhythm chops.
blocks.gap: None. Standard practice for clean tones.

blocks.purpose: Provide consistent attack and punch for the tight upstrokes (skank).
blocks.gap: None. Essential for reggae/ska rhythm guitar.

blocks.purpose: Introduce light grit and controlled breakup without high gain.
blocks.gap: None. Mimics the mild, warm boost of a small Vox or Fender amp.

alternatives.reason: Slightly more aggressive than Green OD for breakup.

blocks.purpose: Wah is not required for this style; keeping it bypassed.
blocks.gap: N/A. The genre does not require a wah effect.

blocks.purpose: Avoid heavy fuzz or high gain.
blocks.gap: N/A. The tone requires clean clarity, not distortion.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the clean, bright character of a Fender or small Vox amp.
blocks.gap: None. Ideal for clear, punchy rhythm tones.

alternatives.reason: A good alternative if US Deluxe is too bright.

blocks.purpose: Provide a small, focused sound that emphasizes clarity and punch.
blocks.gap: None. Matches the '1x12 or 2x12' clue for tight tones.

blocks.purpose: Brighten the high end and cut unnecessary low-end mud.
blocks.gap: None. Fine-tuning for clarity is crucial in reggae/ska.

blocks.purpose: Avoid big chorus as per the musical verdict.
blocks.gap: N/A. The effect is explicitly avoided.

blocks.purpose: Keep the sound dry and focused on rhythm.
blocks.gap: N/A. Ambience is not needed for this style.

blocks.purpose: Add minimal, natural ambience without sounding washed out.
blocks.gap: The verdict suggests a 'dry feel,' so reverb is kept very low to avoid washing out the skank.

alternatives.reason: A slightly more controlled ambience than Room, but Room works well at low mix.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism by swapping the default 2x12 IR for a more specific, vintage-voiced small cab to enhance reggae/ska clarity.

proposals.reason: Enhance the bright, punchy sound needed for skank rhythm.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased clarity and definition in the upper mids/highs.
